description: This source file implements the Device.LocalAgent.Controller data model object of a USP (User Services Platform) device. It manages controllers and their associated MTP (Message Transport Protocol) configurations, including initialization, connection management, object validation, role assignment, and message queueing. It also handles UDS (Unix Domain Sockets) controllers, websocket, MQTT, CoAP, STOMP, and other protocol-specific configurations. The code includes functions for starting/stopping the module, managing instances, validating data, and facilitating communication with controllers.
